# React Magic UI

> Animated, copy-paste components for React built with Tailwind CSS and Motion.

## components

- [Animated Circular Progress Bar](https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/docs/components/animated-circular-progress-bar): Animated Circular Progress Bar is a component that displays a circular gauge with a percentage value. Registry: https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/r/animated-circular-progress-bar.json
- [Animated List](https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/docs/components/animated-list): A list that animates each item in sequence with a delay. Used to showcase notifications or events on your landing page. Registry: https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/r/animated-list.json
- [Avatar Circles](https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/docs/components/avatar-circles): Overlapping circles of avatars. Registry: https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/r/avatar-circles.json
- [Bento Grid](https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/docs/components/bento-grid): Bento grid is a layout used to showcase the features of a product in a simple and elegant way. Registry: https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/r/bento-grid.json
- [Code Comparison](https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/docs/components/code-comparison): A component which compares two code snippets side by side. Dependency-free: plain code gets Shiki-style `[!code highlight|++|--|focus]` notations, and any highlighter (e.g. Shiki) can be plugged in. Registry: https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/r/code-comparison.json
- [Dock](https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/docs/components/dock): An implementation of the MacOS dock using React, Tailwind CSS and Motion. Registry: https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/r/dock.json
- [Dotted Map](https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/docs/components/dotted-map): A dotted world map rendered as SVG, with markers, optional pulses and custom marker overlays. Registry: https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/r/dotted-map.json
- [File Tree](https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/docs/components/file-tree): A component used to showcase the folder and file structure of a directory. Registry: https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/r/file-tree.json
- [Globe](https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/docs/components/globe): An autorotating, interactive and highly performant globe made using WebGL. Registry: https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/r/globe.json
- [Hero Video Dialog](https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/docs/components/hero-video-dialog): A hero video thumbnail with a play button that opens the video in an animated dialog. Registry: https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/r/hero-video-dialog.json
- [Icon Cloud](https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/docs/components/icon-cloud): An interactive 3D sphere of icons or images that rotates with the pointer; click an icon to bring it to the front. Registry: https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/r/icon-cloud.json
- [Lens](https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/docs/components/lens): A lens that magnifies whatever is under the pointer, or sits at a fixed position. Registry: https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/r/lens.json
- [Marquee](https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/docs/components/marquee): An infinite scrolling component that can be used to display text, images, or videos. Registry: https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/r/marquee.json
- [Orbiting Circles](https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/docs/components/orbiting-circles): A collection of circles which move in orbit along a circular path. Registry: https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/r/orbiting-circles.json
- [Pointer](https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/docs/components/pointer): Replaces the cursor with a custom animated pointer while hovering a container. Registry: https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/r/pointer.json
- [Progressive Blur](https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/docs/components/progressive-blur): A blur that gradually strengthens toward an edge, for fading out scrolling content or images. Registry: https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/r/progressive-blur.json
- [Scroll Progress](https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/docs/components/scroll-progress): Animated scroll progress bar for your pages. Registry: https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/r/scroll-progress.json
- [Smooth Cursor](https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/docs/components/smooth-cursor): A page-wide custom cursor that follows the pointer on a spring and leans into the direction of travel. Registry: https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/r/smooth-cursor.json
- [Terminal](https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/docs/components/terminal): An implementation of the MacOS terminal. Useful for showcasing a command line interface. Registry: https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/r/terminal.json

## special-effects

- [Animated Beam](https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/docs/components/animated-beam): An animated beam of light which travels along a path. Useful for showcasing the integration features of a website. Registry: https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/r/animated-beam.json
- [Theme Toggler](https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/docs/components/animated-theme-toggler): A light / dark toggle that reveals the new theme with a View Transition, as a circle, polygon or star growing from the button. Registry: https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/r/animated-theme-toggler.json
- [Backlight](https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/docs/components/backlight): A backlight glow effect for videos, images, and SVGs. Registry: https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/r/backlight.json
- [Border Beam](https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/docs/components/border-beam): An animated beam of light which travels along the border of its container. Registry: https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/r/border-beam.json
- [Confetti](https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/docs/components/confetti): Confetti animations are best used to delight your users when something special happens. Registry: https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/r/confetti.json
- [Cool Mode](https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/docs/components/cool-mode): Sprays playful particles — circles, images or emoji — from the pointer while you press the wrapped element. Registry: https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/r/cool-mode.json
- [Glare Hover](https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/docs/components/glare-hover): A diagonal glare that sweeps across its content on hover, driven by CSS variables (angle, size, duration, colour). Registry: https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/r/glare-hover.json
- [Magic Card](https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/docs/components/magic-card): A spotlight effect that follows your mouse cursor and highlights borders on hover. Registry: https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/r/magic-card.json
- [Meteors](https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/docs/components/meteors): A meteor shower effect. Registry: https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/r/meteors.json
- [Neon Gradient Card](https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/docs/components/neon-gradient-card): A beautiful neon card effect. Registry: https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/r/neon-gradient-card.json
- [Particles](https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/docs/components/particles): A canvas of drifting particles that are gently attracted to the pointer, for backgrounds with some depth. Registry: https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/r/particles.json
- [Pixel Image](https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/docs/components/pixel-image): A component that displays an image with a pixelated effect, creating a retro aesthetic. Registry: https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/r/pixel-image.json
- [Shine Border](https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/docs/components/shine-border): Shine border is an animated background border effect. Registry: https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/r/shine-border.json
- [Warp Background](https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/docs/components/warp-background): A card with a time warping background effect. Registry: https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/r/warp-background.json

## animations

- [Blur Fade](https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/docs/components/blur-fade): Blur fade in and out animation. Used to smoothly fade in and out content. Registry: https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/r/blur-fade.json

## text-animations

- [Animated Gradient Text](https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/docs/components/animated-gradient-text): An animated gradient background which transitions between colors for text. Registry: https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/r/animated-gradient-text.json
- [Animated Shiny Text](https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/docs/components/animated-shiny-text): A light glare effect which pans across text making it appear as if it is shimmering. Registry: https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/r/animated-shiny-text.json
- [Aurora Text](https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/docs/components/aurora-text): A beautiful aurora text effect. Registry: https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/r/aurora-text.json
- [Comic Text](https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/docs/components/comic-text): Comic-book lettering with a halftone fill, thick outline and a pop-in animation. Registry: https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/r/comic-text.json
- [Dia Text Reveal](https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/docs/components/dia-text-reveal): A colourful gradient band that sweeps across text to reveal it, inspired by the Dia browser. Registry: https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/r/dia-text-reveal.json
- [Highlighter](https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/docs/components/highlighter): A hand-drawn highlight, underline, box or circle that animates around inline text. Registry: https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/r/highlighter.json
- [Hyper Text](https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/docs/components/hyper-text): A text animation that scrambles letters before revealing the final text. Registry: https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/r/hyper-text.json
- [Kinetic Text](https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/docs/components/kinetic-text): Letters that swell in weight and spacing as the pointer passes over them, with a ripple into their neighbours. Registry: https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/r/kinetic-text.json
- [Line Shadow Text](https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/docs/components/line-shadow-text): A text component with a moving line shadow. Registry: https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/r/line-shadow-text.json
- [Morphing Text](https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/docs/components/morphing-text): A dynamic text morphing component that blends smoothly from one string to the next. Registry: https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/r/morphing-text.json
- [Number Ticker](https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/docs/components/number-ticker): Animate numbers to count up or down to a target number. Registry: https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/r/number-ticker.json
- [Scroll Based Velocity](https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/docs/components/scroll-based-velocity): Scrolling rows of content whose speed and direction follow the page scroll velocity. Registry: https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/r/scroll-based-velocity.json
- [Sparkles Text](https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/docs/components/sparkles-text): A dynamic text that generates continuous sparkles with smooth transitions, perfect for highlighting text with animated stars. Registry: https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/r/sparkles-text.json
- [Spinning Text](https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/docs/components/spinning-text): Text laid out around a circle that rotates continuously. Registry: https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/r/spinning-text.json
- [Text 3D Flip](https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/docs/components/text-3d-flip): Letters that flip in 3D, one after another, when hovered. Registry: https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/r/text-3d-flip.json
- [Text Animate](https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/docs/components/text-animate): A text animation component that animates text using a variety of different animations. Registry: https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/r/text-animate.json
- [Text Reveal](https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/docs/components/text-reveal): Fade in text as you scroll down the page. Registry: https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/r/text-reveal.json
- [Typing Animation](https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/docs/components/typing-animation): Characters appearing in typed animation. Registry: https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/r/typing-animation.json
- [Video Text](https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/docs/components/video-text): A component that displays text with a video playing in the background. Registry: https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/r/video-text.json
- [Word Rotate](https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/docs/components/word-rotate): A vertical rotation of words. Registry: https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/r/word-rotate.json

## buttons

- [Interactive Hover Button](https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/docs/components/interactive-hover-button): Interactive hover button: a dot grows to fill the button and the label slides out for an arrow. Registry: https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/r/interactive-hover-button.json
- [Pulsating Button](https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/docs/components/pulsating-button): An animated pulsating button useful for capturing attention of users. Registry: https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/r/pulsating-button.json
- [Rainbow Button](https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/docs/components/rainbow-button): An animated button with a rainbow effect. Registry: https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/r/rainbow-button.json
- [Ripple Button](https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/docs/components/ripple-button): An animated button with ripple useful for user engagement. Registry: https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/r/ripple-button.json
- [Shimmer Button](https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/docs/components/shimmer-button): A button with a shimmering light which travels around the perimeter. Registry: https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/r/shimmer-button.json
- [Shiny Button](https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/docs/components/shiny-button): A shiny button component with dynamic styles in the dark mode or light mode. Registry: https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/r/shiny-button.json

## backgrounds

- [Animated Grid Pattern](https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/docs/components/animated-grid-pattern): An animated background grid pattern made with SVGs, fully customizable using Tailwind CSS. Registry: https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/r/animated-grid-pattern.json
- [Dot Pattern](https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/docs/components/dot-pattern): A background dot pattern made with SVGs, fully customizable using Tailwind CSS. Registry: https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/r/dot-pattern.json
- [Flickering Grid](https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/docs/components/flickering-grid): A flickering grid background drawn on a canvas, fully customizable using Tailwind CSS. Registry: https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/r/flickering-grid.json
- [Grid Pattern](https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/docs/components/grid-pattern): A background grid pattern made with SVGs, fully customizable using Tailwind CSS. Registry: https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/r/grid-pattern.json
- [Hexagon Pattern](https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/docs/components/hexagon-pattern): A background hexagon pattern made with SVGs, fully customizable using Tailwind CSS. Registry: https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/r/hexagon-pattern.json
- [Interactive Grid Pattern](https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/docs/components/interactive-grid-pattern): An interactive background grid pattern made with SVGs, fully customizable using Tailwind CSS. Registry: https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/r/interactive-grid-pattern.json
- [Light Rays](https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/docs/components/light-rays): A component with animated light rays which shine down from above. Registry: https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/r/light-rays.json
- [Noise Texture](https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/docs/components/noise-texture): An SVG fractal noise layer using feTurbulence, desaturation, and contrast controls for subtle texture overlays. Registry: https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/r/noise-texture.json
- [Retro Grid](https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/docs/components/retro-grid): An animated scrolling retro grid effect, rendered with WebGL and a CSS fallback. Registry: https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/r/retro-grid.json
- [Ripple](https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/docs/components/ripple): An animated ripple effect typically used behind elements to emphasize them. Registry: https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/r/ripple.json
- [Striped Pattern](https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/docs/components/striped-pattern): A background striped pattern made with SVGs, fully customizable using Tailwind CSS. Registry: https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/r/striped-pattern.json

## device-mocks

- [Android](https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/docs/components/android): A mockup of an Android device. Registry: https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/r/android.json
- [iPhone](https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/docs/components/iphone): A mockup of the iPhone. Registry: https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/r/iphone.json
- [Safari](https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/docs/components/safari): A Safari browser mockup to showcase your website. Registry: https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/r/safari.json
